title: San Bernardino, CA — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]
description: Complete guide to San Bernardino, CA: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

San Bernardino is a city in CA with a population of 222,101. Inland Empire city with Route 66 history, mountains, and more affordable than coastal CA. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 9b growing zone supports Warm to hot — citrus, tropical fruits, year-round growing. A relatively small share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 280 sunny days a year. Reported crime rates are relatively high. The population skews young, with a median age of 31.9.
